a.text: 'Remember this family name. The rest has nothing to do with you.'
'I hate you. And I hate them. I should love you, but right now I hate every last one of you.'
'When you grow up... you'll change everything.'

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Thunder.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And nothing more.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It's late autumn. If you wait till winter, the roads will be hard to traverse.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hui-chieh... you should go back.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: 'Go back'?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: To where? Lungmen?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I've already told you what you want to know.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: So you should understand, all that lies in front of you is none of your business.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hah... I think you've gotten old, Uncle.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you were five years younger, we would have crossed swords already.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Your temperament has changed too.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You don’t have many issues here, over the past few days at this posthouse.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Because I still don't trust you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What you said... about the Grand Preceptor, about your brother—that 'other uncle' I've never met, and the old True Lung...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's not my place to comment, but if I have to say something, I'm just glad you're not the one running Yan.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I cannot argue with that...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I really do want to know what was going on in your head when you left Baizao, why Mother followed you to Lungmen, and why she stayed.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But at this point, I'm not expecting to hear a fair answer—or an objective account of the past from you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So I'll find the answers myself—and I'm not leaving until I do.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You have a knack for messing things up when it matters most, especially when it's about you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: To stop you from doing anything stupid again, or even just to keep you safe—I'm not leaving until I'm done.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So let's both save our breath.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hui-chieh... these past few years, you—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Same as always. Nothing worth sharing.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Perhaps it's better to wait until you're willing...
Ch'en Hui-chieh looks out the window.
The lights of the far-off nomadic city have been dim for days, leaving Baizao's skyline vague at night, like the spine of a Feranmut in hiding.
She tries to imagine the colossal creatures from ancient fables only recently confirmed as real to her.
Fine autumn rain drizzles against the window, like pins and needles on glass.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Still no news.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Then that's the best news we could ask for.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There is no hoping for a positive turn of events, at this point.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So, if anything strange happens in Baizao... Yumen won't hesitate to go to war.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This 'bestial Sui' you talk of, the unrest it might cause, and any battle it might provoke... no one's sure how any of it could turn out.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So this is the secret Great Yan has hidden for over a thousand years... You two are so alike.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There is a strange detail, though.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Time is running out, but in the past ten days, there have been no more than three Messenger parties traveling between Yumen and Baizao.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: When Yumen is facing war, we would expect far more traffic.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Lord Wei, a visitor.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: At a time like this...?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Send them in.
I trust you've been well, Lord Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Likewise, Grand Tutor.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So you're... the Grand Tutor of Yan?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I did not know Lady Ch'en would be here as well.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How do you...?
Ch'en is certain she has never met this old man before.
She cannot tell if it is an austere or kind look in his eyes, but he recognizes her instantly.
Swiftly, he turns that same gaze to Wei Yenwu.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That's another matter, and a long story.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: So you did heed my advice to stay at this posthouse.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I have no grounds to distrust the Grand Tutor.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It has been Messengers, but today the Grand Tutor graces us with a personal visit...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: There is something I must make clear to you, Lord Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hui-chieh, leave us.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Best she stay and hear what I am about to say.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The situation in Baizao...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: After Mid-Autumn, His Imperial Majesty granted him leave to enter the Tomb of Sui, to try and quell the threat posed by the bestial one.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: But the day of the full moon nears, and we've heard nothing from the tomb.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: And yet, at this very moment, five Feranmuts have lurked around Great Yan, with intentions unknown.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The Tianshis of the Chamber of Heaven's Designs along with Yan's finest warriors have stationed themselves near the Feranmuts. Great Yan does not fear the coming battle.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: But the worst outcome we face, is not just fighting five Feranmuts simultaneously.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No way...

steps.name: Indistinct Voice?
steps.text: 'Intentions unknown'—This gray beard sure can talk.

steps.name: Indistinct Voice?
steps.text: With the blood feud of the past few millennia, did you think they'd simply show up on your doorstep bearing gifts?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What... did you say?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'm sure many are advocating for war at this time.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: There is no opinion from any party left to consider.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I fear Great Yan is left with no other choice.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The court must have drafted plenty of plans for this contingency.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Countless plans, and none end without a pyrrhic victory.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: But there is still a method yet to be considered.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Tell me, Grand Tutor. Tell me my brother has never conceived of activating Bu Fan himself—

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: He is the True Lung. The True Lung of Yan.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: If the nation is driven to a corner, he is the only one who can do it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It's absurd!

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Lord Wei.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: As it stands, there is no longer a need to digress.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Not a single man knew of the secret letter sent to Lungmen until the Imperial Guards set off. And I come today without any attempt to conceal my identity.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I'm sure you understand, Lord Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The past... stories from forty years ago, thousands of years ago... it should not end like this.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...And he should never be the one to pay the price.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: No one wants to see the worst-case scenario, but we cannot deceive ourselves.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I must remind you—even if merely for Yan's sake, or for the good of the realm.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: A backup plan is called for.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Please, just slow down a second.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't get it. What does the Grand Tutor mean by a backup plan?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Everything you're saying... what does any of it have to do with Wei Yenwu?

steps.name: Indistinct Voice?
steps.text: You still don't get it?

steps.name: Indistinct Voice?
steps.text: You don't know what a backup plan is? Something you do when things go south.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What... are you talking about?

steps.name: Indistinct Voice?
steps.text: A kingdom cannot be without its king for even a day. A missing True Lung must naturally see his seat filled by another.

steps.name: Indistinct Voice?
steps.text: When father dies, son takes over, and when elder brother leaves, younger returns. That's how it's been for thousands of years.

steps.name: Indistinct Voice?
steps.text: And if there's no other choice, this lass will have no choice but to become the True Lung.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What the hell are you talking about?!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Hui-chieh!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That voice...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did the two of you... not hear any of that?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Lord Wei.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I do not expect you to have considered all possible angles already.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: One must think before one acts, but time is short.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Take care, Lord Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'll see you out.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I didn't get any of what he was saying.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: He had me stay to hear it, but I couldn't make sense of it at all.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hui-chieh...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: All that stuff about Yan probably going to war, but he'll give you time to prepare?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Bu Fan, the Feranmuts... what does any of it have to do with you?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Many mistakes from the past... Some I made myself, but others I was powerless to stop.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I only insist on ensuring those irrevocable mistakes do not affect the rest of you.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Because I've never doubted in your potential to accomplish more than we ever could.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This is the worst time you could be saying that.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: One more thing.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Talulah...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Tell me. Was she well, the last time you met?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No way. I'm not telling you about her right now.

spans.text: telling you about her right now.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you really care, then now is not the time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Aunt Fumizuki doesn't want you to stay a stubborn old man forever, and she's worried about your safety. And I don't want to—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you truly care for anyone but yourself, then don't leave them behind.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tell me, Uncle...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What exactly are you going to do?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It sounds like she's doing fine. Well, not bad, at least.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's not your call to make!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You don't know how much she's sacrificed, and you've no clue what she's—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Enough...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you want to enjoy your pity party here, then have fun.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm going out for some fresh air.
Fine autumn rain continues unabated, like intermittent thoughts left tangled with no end.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I’m sick of you, Wei Yenwu.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You and your precious city.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where are you headed?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Back up north.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: There are people in the mines who need our help.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We're running out of time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Right now?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then what about this farm? What about the people left here?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Some of our comrades are staying. They'll take care of each other.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You could join them too, if you're so inclined.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I can't just let you go...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You could follow us instead.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'd like your help, if it's on the table.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I believe in your words, and your ideals... a place where the Infected are judged fairly... and can live, truly live.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But that place is not here—not in the past, not in the present.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The place we seek lies only in the future.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And must make our way there.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Alright, so on we go... and what next?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did my past catch up with me... or did I go looking for it? Heh, guess it's less history and more a reality I haven't faced yet.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Talulah, if you were here... what would you think about all these?

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: Hmph. Overcautious and indecisive. Your courage is for naught.

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: This lass is unlike her ancestors.

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: That first Lung's descendants must number at least tens of thousands over the millennia, how many of them were heroes, and how many were mediocrities?

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: How much can this sliver of that bloodline even accomplish?

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: With a mind this turbid, as if trapped in a dream, can we really trust her with anything?

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: Or is it because those old blockheads refuse to bend? No wonder the youths are too inept to handle things on their own.

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: She's been on quite the journey, so she must have other special skills beyond her brute swordplay.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just who the hell are you?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Enough hiding!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Come out here and show yourselves!
The vague, mysterious voice speaks again, but she hears it clearly this time.
Only now is Ch'en Hui-chieh sure the whispers that have plagued her all night are no mere hallucination.

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: Hah, just look at the girl. Inexperienced, yet quick to anger.

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: I'm glad you want to know, but if you truly seek your answer, why not find it yourself—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What the...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What was that?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: From the posthouse?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Lady Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you all standing around for... did something happen?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: When was the last time you saw Lord Wei?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Barely an hour ago.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: So you don't know his whereabouts either.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wait, you mean—

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Half an hour ago, Lord Wei went to rest and dismissed us.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: The posthouse owner just realized the room was empty when delivering the food.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: We've searched the premises, and found no trace.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Lord Wei is... missing.
No note left in the room.
An empty room, as if it never housed a guest.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So he actually managed to slip out, with all of you watching.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Again... yet again, Wei Yenwu.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Lord Wei received a letter, personally penned by the True Lung, summoning him to the capital. We tried in vain to dissuade him. We could only follow.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Let us tentatively assume he is making his way there.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: We failed to ensure his safety, and our crime is unforgivable. However, I fear entering the capital now would only—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't worry.
Ch'en interrupts the Shadow Guard.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Whatever the case, he left without a word.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So this time... I'll find him.
